promptBinding.prompt: Produce ONE native 4K landscape bare Kingdom terrain for STONE AGE (prehistoric earth, natural limestone, flint outcroppings, patches of wild moss and native grass, earthen spine road, rustic timber/stone river crossing, primeval forest margin). Input 1 is the versioned geometry guide; input 2 is the prepared bare base/material reference. Preserve their camera, civic terrace and Hall contact/entrance-apron reservation, 17 empty pads, continuous roads/approaches, lower gate reservation, right river and single registered crossing. Render natural realistic/semi-realistic three-quarter aerial ground with coherent upper-left light and era materials. Guide colours/labels/boxes are instructions and must disappear. No mutable Hall/buildings/Walls/gate/towers/units/workers/vehicles/pickups, HUD/text/grid or painted plot outlines. No sky/obstructions on required ground. Retain natural dressing outside reserved regions. Deliver ONE image.
